reason: The cited evidence (E2) directly supports HfO₂ scale formation and reduced weight gain for a 120 μm Hf coating on VZrHfNbTa, but provides no data on cyclic annealing, scale adhesion under cycling, or performance at 1873 K; the cyclic annealing premise and the specific temperature/cycling conditions are unsupported.
premises: Hf coating on VZrHfNbTa HEA forms a dense, protective HfO₂ scale during oxidation
A ~120 μm Hf coating significantly reduces weight gain compared to uncoated alloy
Cyclic annealing improves coating uniformity and interfacial homogenization
The HfO₂ scale remains adherent and crack-free under static and cyclic conditions at 1873 K
Zirconium diffusion in the coating is beneficial or manageable
